sources.primary_title: Ericsson reaffirms commitment to Saudi Arabia’s digital future at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Ericsson has announced its participation in LEAP 2026, marking its fifth consecutive year at the event. Under the theme "Enter New Horizons," the company will showcase developments in 5G Advanced, AI-powered networks, and mission-critical connectivity. The announcement highlights Ericsson's commitment to Saudi Vision 2030 and the Kingdom's digital transformation. Key demonstrations will include 5G Standalone, programmable networks, and AI-driven automation designed to improve network operations and support emerging applications. Håkan Cervell, President of Ericsson Saudi Arabia, emphasized that the innovations will enable service providers and enterprises to strengthen digital infrastructure. The event also coincides with Ericsson's 150th anniversary and nearly 50 years of partnership with Saudi Arabia. This angle is distinct and fully supported by Ericsson's official press release and multiple news outlets, confirming its newsworthiness for LEAP 2026 coverage.
sources.verified_key_facts: Ericsson will participate in LEAP 2026 from August 31 to September 3, 2026, in Riyadh; The showcase theme is "Enter New Horizons"; Ericsson will present developments in 5G Advanced, AI-powered networks, and mission-critical connectivity; Demonstrations include 5G Standalone, programmable networks, and AI-driven automation; Håkan Cervell, President of Ericsson Saudi Arabia, stated the innovations support Saudi Arabia's digital transformation and Vision 2030; The event coincides with Ericsson's 150th anniversary and nearly 50 years of partnership with Saudi Arabia
